name: Can opener
summary: Squeezing the handles pushes a sharp wheel through the lid of a can, and turning the key rolls the can round so the wheel cuts all the way.

parts.name: Upper handle
parts.role: One of two long handles squeezed together.

parts.name: Lower handle
parts.role: The second handle, hinged to the first.

parts.name: Cutting wheel
parts.role: A small sharp disc that pierces and slices the lid.

parts.name: Toothed wheel
parts.role: A ridged wheel that grips under the can's rim and drives it round.

parts.name: Turning key
parts.role: The butterfly knob you turn by hand.
